📋 Lean-Bulk Ground Rules (25yo • 173 cm • 54 → 69 kg)
Weekly rate & nutritionGain 0.25–0.5 kg/week. Eat a ~300–500 kcal daily surplus with 1.6–2.2 g protein/kg (~90–120 g/day).
Double-progression ruleHit the top of the rep range on all sets with 1–2 reps in reserve (RIR), then add +2.5 kg (upper) or +5 kg (lower).
Warm-up & rest periodsWarm-up = 2–3 light ramp-up sets of the first lift (zero cardio). Rest 2–3 min on big compounds, 60–90 s on accessories.
Recovery & deloadsSleep 7–9 h nightly. Mon & Tue are full rest. Deload every 6th week (Weeks 6, 12, 18…) at ~60% of normal loads.
Weekly schedule & volume splitMon–Tue: Rest • Wed D1 Push: 2 Chest, 2 Shoulders, 2 Triceps • Thu D2 Pull: 4 Back, 2 Biceps • Fri D3 Legs+Abs: 2 Quads, 2 Hams, 1 Glutes, 1 Calves, 2 Abs • Sat D4 Shoulders+Arms: 2 Shoulders, 2 Biceps, 2 Triceps • Sun D5 Chest+Back: 3 Chest, 3 Back, 1 Loaded Carry.
